title: The Garden of Words
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Takao, a first-year high-school student who dreams of making shoes, skips class on rainy mornings to sketch in a Tokyo park, where he keeps meeting Yukino, a quiet woman in her twenties who drinks beer there. Their rainy-day meetings grow into a bond before each learns the other's situation; the manga adapts Makoto Shinkai's film and adds family subplots (Kodansha and Comix Wave blurbs via MU and AniList; ANN review).
life_message: Words and small kindnesses can carry a hurting person through, and each must learn to walk on alone.

content.note: Feelings between a first-year high-school student and an adult woman who is a teacher at his school (MU Student-Teacher Relationship, Age Gap; AniList Teacher spoiler tag). ANN does not report physical content (to verify).
The woman drinks 'a morning beer' in the park (Kodansha blurb via MU).
Students bullying a teacher is a major plot point (ANN; MU Bullying, Bullied Female Lead); traumas and unhappiness (ANN).
Adaptation of an anime film (MU Based on an Anime).

dominant: Healing through connection; coming of age; the power of words and poetry

frames.aligns: Kindness to a woman wounded by bullying; Takao's vocation as a craftsman.
frames.concerns: Romantic feelings between a student and a teacher.

frames.aligns: Cruel words shown to wound (Proverbs-like theme).
Words have power to heal or harm.
Ninth-commandment theme: rumors ruin a career.
Pursuit of a dream through work.
Attention to workplace bullying and mental health.
frames.concerns: Power imbalance of teacher and student.

frames.aligns: Respect for a guru-like figure tested.
Right speech: rumor causes suffering; impermanence of rain.
Mental health and bullying taken seriously.
Healing through love and right thought.
Seasonal rain, a Japanese garden and classical tanka honored.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Hurt from rumors met with withdrawal and healing, not retaliation (Kodansha blurb; ANN).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Takao skips class to pursue his own dream (AniList; MU).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Strained ties with brother; mother leaves (ANN).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Student and teacher meet as equals in the garden (ANN).

folkways.japan: Uses classical Japanese tanka from the Man'yoshu tradition and the rainy season (tsuyu) as the story's frame.

delivery.evidence: ANN praises 'subtle symbolism' and a gentle, hopeful tone.
delivery.note: Meaning rests on imagery and poetry rather than stated morals.

winners_losers: Both Takao and the woman are treated with sympathy; the bullies who spread rumors are the source of harm (ANN; Kodansha blurb).
to_verify: How the student-teacher feelings are resolved and whether anything physical occurs.
ANN mentions Takao cutting himself with a leatherworking tool; check whether accidental or self-harm.
